rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
$|\vec{a}\times\vec{b}| = ab\sin\theta$, directed by the right-hand rule; it is the area of the parallelogram on $\vec{a}$ and $\vec{b}$.
$\vec{a}\times\vec{b} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ a_1 & a_2 & a_3 \\ b_1 & b_2 & b_3 \end{vmatrix}$, and $\vec{a}\times\vec{b} = \vec{0} \iff$ they are parallel.
